# Synthetic HEIC fixtures

Generated by `scripts/generate-heic-fixtures.swift` on macOS with Core Image and
ImageIO (Swift 6.1.2, macOS SDK 15.5). These are repository-owned synthetic RGB
gradients, not camera photos. Regenerate on macOS with:

```sh
swift scripts/generate-heic-fixtures.swift tests/fixtures/heic
```

- `p3-10.heic`: 128 x 96, genuine 10-bit Display P3; checks precision and profile.
- `p3-orientation-1..8.heic`: the same asymmetric gradient with each orientation
  and a synthetic TIFF artist marker that must not survive preparation.
- `pq-10.heic`, `hlg-10.heic`: HDR transfers intentionally refused by v1.

Fixtures do not establish physical iPhone picker behavior, phone rendering, or
faithful handling of every camera/HEIF variant. Those require preview/device QA.
